verdict.rationale: Published board power, connector requirements and cooling guidance are a fair question for any GPU or accelerator card, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never gives a TDP/TBP, power connector or cooling specification for the MI325X. The only card-specific item is an architecture spec row covering CUs, memory and gfx target, with no power or thermal figures. The vendor product page, which might carry these specs, was unreachable to the crawler.
